title: Strange deaths of abduction researchers, two John Macks hit by cars

tellings.quote: And if I recall, another guy named John Mack was hit by a car in the same day, right in in England.

plain: Several people who studied alien abductions are said to have died in strange ways, including John Mack, an abduction researcher, and another man also named John Mack, who were both supposedly hit by cars on the same day in England. The researcher Tim Alberino tells it from memory without a source ("if I recall"), and also names the abduction researchers Karla Turner, Budd Hopkins and Barbara Bartholic. He tells it to hint that the deaths might not be chance.
